maya: Quick sanity check — after flipping on speculative decode + int8 for ember-7b I get ~1.8x token/sec in the server logs but a small drop on our convo quality checks. Anyone else seeing this? :thinking:
ben: Yep. Latency and throughput up. Quality dip seems subtle but reproducible on the internal convo set. Not dramatic but non-zero.
li: Can you paste the eval numbers? which eval suite?
maya: Using `convo-qna-v2` (2k samples). Quick paste: ```baseline: ppl=13.2, acc=0.812, qscore=0.87; spec+int8: ppl=13.9, acc=0.798, qscore=0.84```
ben: Interesting — ppl up ~5%, acc down ~1.7% absolute. Prompt-dependent as I said; for short prompts it's fine, for long multi-turn it degrades more.
li: Running the harness now on #latest-build (tag: ember-7b-int8-spec-2026-03-21). Command: `./eval_harness --suite convo-qna-v2 --model ember-7b-int8-spec --seed 42 --nproc 12`
sam: FYI ops: the dedicated pool had a rollout yesterday that changed batching window from 8ms -> 12ms. Could that interact with speculation?
maya: Good call. The experiments were done on the dedicated pool. I also tested locally with micro-batching disabled and saw similar but slightly smaller drop.
li: Early results (partial): ```n=200 samples interim: ppl baseline=13.3 -> spec=13.8, acc 0.81->0.79, time/token 0.42ms->0.24ms``` Looks consistent. Pushing full run to CI.
ben: Do we have trace logs showing where speculation misfires? i.e., how often the speculative path is corrected by fallback and the cost of correction?
ci-bot: CI job #6421 started: ember-7b-int8-spec full convo-qna-v2 (2000 samples).
maya: I dumped a small trace: ```speculative_attempts=1.02e6, fallbacks=12.3k, fallback_rate=1.2%``` Not huge but fallbacks clustered on long-turn arithmetic/formatting prompts.
li: Hypothesis: int8 quant changes logits calibration -> speculative prefix picks wrong high-prob tokens more often, and long-turn prompts amplify error accumulation. Two-pronged check: 1) run with softmax temperature adjustment during speculative stage; 2) disable KV-cache warmup for first 8 tokens to see effect.
ben: Agreed. Also try toggling the speculation depth parameter from default 3 -> 1 to see regression vs speed trade-off.
sam: Ops note: If we change speculation depth we should do a canary on a small traffic slice (10%) to verify no major regressions in live traffic.
maya: I'll run ablation: (A) depth=1 (B) depth=3 + temp=0.9 (C) depth=3 + disable-kv-warmup. Will report numbers.
li: If you can, include token level entropy stats (`mean_entropy` per step) — would help confirm calibration shift.
maya: Will do. Preliminary plan timeline: run ablations today, full CI by EOD, then canary tomorrow AM if ok.
ben: Thanks. If regression persists, we should try fp16-spec path as a comparison to separate quantization vs speculative decode effects.
maya: Good plan. Will post results here. :thumbsup:
